desc: KolibriOS is a compact operating system built around an assembly-language kernel. Its lightweight graphical desktop includes text and image tools, utilities, and games. Explore an alternative to Windows and Linux with a small footprint and a focus on speed.
creator: tokaevUser

desc: Damn Small Linux is a lightweight Linux distribution designed to provide a useful desktop with minimal resource requirements. Explore the Linux terminal, manage files, edit documents, and try a collection of compact desktop tools. A practical introduction to classic Linux and low-resource computing.
creator: tokaevUser
